To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) internal integration and external integration are both positively related to internal innovation potential and collaborative innovation potential; 2) both internal innovation potential and external innovation potential are positively related to financing performance; 3) collaborative open innovation positively moderates the relationship between internal integration and internal innovation potential and the relationship between external integration and internal innovation.
